title: Create and recover build archives on the GA SDK
goal: Package and recover trusted build output with a supported tar helper when SDK 11 GA inbox archive task execution fails.

selectionNotes: Windows SDK10/SDK11 canonical helper and glob controls are exercised. SDK11 GA inbox TarDirectory fails; use the supported helper fallback.
Target 11 only; no older-target/newer-SDK or Framework MSBuild execution claim.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Managed consumer target exercised on Windows.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Intended language mode of the original managed consumer; the XML glob configuration itself is language-neutral.

platforms: Windows x64 measured; other platforms not exercised.
prerequisites: Select an absolute compatible dotnet executable and inspect global.json and inherited build configuration.
constraints: TarDirectory and Untar require .NET-hosted MSBuild; .NET Framework MSBuild.exe does not provide these tasks.
Only trusted archives belong in this build workflow.
Target 11 only; .NET 10 sources are previous-release comparisons, not an additional historical foundation or a tested older-target route.
Playbook only serves embedded guidance. No provisioning, registry push, telemetry transmission or consumer mutation is performed by consulting it.
stabilityLimitations: GA inbox archive task failure remains explicit; helper execution is separate from inbox-task execution.
